scope: Research advice only. No commercial approval, gate changes or outbound contact.
observed_internal_facts: Live health: fresh source, 57,139/57,139 source locations checked, 57,205 active mirrored locations, delivery disabled, checkoutReady false, 15 completed seven-day polls vs minimum 24.

Read-only DB aggregates match live health scale. 30,591 active Social Care Org locations and 18,103 distinct provider IDs within those. All CQC records include dentists and other healthcare; 57,205 is not the adult social care market.
14,430 active Social Care Org locations include Domiciliary care service. Multi-service categories overlap.

Registration dates April-September 2026 across social care: 236,129,216,185,108,156 locations. September includes 87 distinct provider organisations. These are registration entries, not proof of new businesses, openings or buying intent.

Recent-effective registration ledger: 312 distinct locations across all CQC sectors, 308 have source URL, snapshot hash and effective date. Social care subset is 156 locations; by region North West 45 locations/13 organisations, London 18/18, South East 20/17, North East 1/1. Low-volume regions risk empty weekly digests.

No effective dates populated for these rating_changed events. Exclude them from promises of genuine grade movement without independent verification.

Essential GBP599+VAT/year for 12 monthly personalised care home quality benchmark reports; Premium combination GBP3399+VAT/year. Pure rating summaries face strong price competition.
Advertises care-sector search and targeting dashboard GBP199/year. Feature quality, subscriber numbers and operator independence not audited.

regional_monitoring.offer: Curated regional care-market monitoring for compliance consultancies: verified new registration entries, buyer relevance, source links, saved client/provider list, manual weekly delivery at first.
regional_monitoring.initial_cash: Current GBP150 four-week Digest pilot after terms and delivery acceptance.
regional_monitoring.repeat: Proposed explicitly opt-in ongoing service; GBP150/month test hypothesis. More expensive Radar only if measurable workflow value supports it.
regional_monitoring.retention: Recurring review and follow-up workflow; client-specific lists and outcome tracking. Not validated by paying buyers.
regional_monitoring.risks: Sparse regional signal supply; free CQC source; rating/closure claims unsupported; no automatic renewal authorised.

territory_research.offer: Territory Opportunity Brief for care suppliers or specialist staffing sales teams: scoped market map, organisation-deduplicated shortlist, verifiable reasons and three-month action plan.
territory_research.initial_cash: Current GBP745 one-off scope; human reviewed delivery after release acceptance.
territory_research.repeat: Proposed quarterly re-research at GBP745 each, separately accepted. Four briefs/year GBP2980; demand hypothesis, no subscription approval.
territory_research.retention: Sales planning, refresh existing accounts and next territory as decisions recur.
territory_research.risks: One-off alone does not generate MRR. Public registration does not imply vacancy/buying need. Account list value must exceed commodity data; ongoing fulfilment labour.

licensed_feed.offer: Scoped licensed CQC registration and identity feed for care software, CRM or multi-client consultancy tools, maintained into the buyer's system using stable IDs, replay and provenance.
licensed_feed.initial_cash: None proven immediately. Historical GBP6000/year pilot anchor; require buyer-funded integration and explicit approval to reopen stopped line.
licensed_feed.repeat: Annual maintained service licence after paid integration proof.
licensed_feed.retention: Customer's operational integration creates ongoing use if maintenance cost and reliability beat direct CQC API.
licensed_feed.risks: Free upstream API, long integration/procurement cycle, SLA/security/support and source-quality gates; zero validated buyers.

provider_benchmarking.offer: Monthly public CQC rating comparison report for care groups.
provider_benchmarking.initial_cash: No current approved product; compare with LaingBuisson GBP599/year.
provider_benchmarking.risks: Current rating movement ledger quality and competitor price. Requires richer verified evidence to stand out.

static_directory.offer: Raw directory exports and contact lists.
static_directory.initial_cash: Removed from current catalogue; low price generic list sales possible only with new approval.
static_directory.repeat: Weak: buyer can obtain free source and import once.
static_directory.risks: Free CQC data, GBP199/year competitor, zero provider emails, no differentiation.

inspection_readiness.offer: Inspection mock audit or AI readiness pack sold directly to providers.
inspection_readiness.initial_cash: GBP950 is in an old cross-project plan; no validated CareGist offer or audited production audit engine in this review.
inspection_readiness.risks: Requires domain experts, provider internal evidence, delivery capacity, insurance and evolving assessment framework. Different business and product from current CareGist data capabilities.

paid_listings.offer: Sell sponsored or premium provider directory listings.
paid_listings.retention: Only if consumer traffic and provider enquiries create measurable value.
paid_listings.risks: No traffic/enquiry conversion proof; claims and leads remain gated. Large directory count is not consumer demand.

decision_rules: Do not invent buyer validation, likelihood of sale, renewal probability, or future revenue.
Compare narrow candidate jobs and current capabilities; no model decision opens any gate.
2026 recommendation should favour first cash from a reviewed existing offer; 2027 and 2028 should favour demonstrated repeat value and integration durability, conditionally on validation.
All numerical prices for new ongoing packages are hypotheses. Existing one-off prices are catalogue prices, not market validation.
